title: Six aircraft at Kai Tak: which one should you fly?
dek: Four free airliners, Concorde and the An-225: their approach speeds, flight decks and how they differ.
description: Fly Kai Tak has six aircraft: 747-400, 777-200, A330-300, A340-300, Concorde and An-225. Compare approach speeds, flight decks and which to fly first.
hero_alt: The left wing of a 747-400 with its winglet, two engines and the tail fin, over a bay and green hills.
hero_caption: The 747-400, the aircraft the sim starts you in.

zh.title: 啟德嘅六款飛機：你應該揀邊款？
zh.dek: 四款免費客機、協和式同 An-225：進場速度、駕駛艙同分別。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 有六款飛機：747-400、777-200、A330-300、A340-300、協和式同 An-225。比較進場速度同駕駛艙，睇吓應該揀邊款。
zh.hero_alt: 波音 747-400 嘅左翼，連翼尖小翼、兩部引擎同垂直尾翼，下面係海灣同青綠色山嶺。
zh.hero_caption: 波音 747-400，模擬器預設用嘅飛機。
